android.checkout-metadata: Android uses mobile purchase attribution tokens instead of browser checkout metadata.
android.cookieless-consent: Android consent requires a platform-specific ATT/storage design.
android.dom-autocapture: Android captures screens and lifecycle but never inspects native view trees.
android.pageleave-resilience: Android records application lifecycle rather than pageleave.
android.pageviews: Android records named screens instead of browser pageviews.
android.scroll: Android does not inspect native scroll views.

ios.scroll: iOS does not inspect native scroll views.
